summary.text: Kyle Bragg is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 63A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Samantha Sencer-Mura (D).
He has run unsuccessfully for the same seat several times, in 2014, 2016, 2018 and 2022.

paragraphs.text: Kyle Bragg was the Republican candidate for Minnesota House District 63A in 2014, 2016, 2018 and 2022 and lost each time.
He lost to incumbent Jim Davnie in 2016 and 2018, and to Samantha Sencer-Mura in 2022.
